findings.title: Do not send the plaintext API key to audit telemetry.
findings.rationale: key is a live credential, but this call passes it to audit. Any audit sink that serializes or retains event fields can expose the credential and allow unauthorized API access. Record only non-secret metadata, such as user and key_id; use a one-way fingerprint only if correlation is required.
